overview: The Climate Equity Council reviewed upcoming summer outreach events, coordinated planning for the Harvest Your Energy Festival, and received updates on city energy programs and staff transitions. The council decided not to meet in July and set its next meeting for August 19, 2026.

items.title: Meeting Minutes and Schedule
items.summary: The council moved to review prior minutes and voted to bypass a July meeting, setting the next meeting date for August 19, 2026.

items.title: Staff Transitions and Intern Introductions
items.summary: Climate Planner Brenda Pike announced her departure at the end of July and introduced Tufts graduate interns Natalie Rodman and Kyla, who are assisting with city climate initiatives.

items.title: Upcoming Community Outreach Events
items.summary: Members reviewed summer tabling and engagement opportunities, including the Summer Eats kickoff, Farmers Market, National Night Out, and Hoops and Hope.

items.title: Harvest Your Energy Festival Planning
items.summary: Intern Kyla presented preparations for the October 17 festival at Riverbend Park, and the council discussed outreach strategies, flyer translations, clothing donations, and sponsor recruitment.

items.title: City Sustainability and Energy Updates
items.summary: Pike reported on Electrify Medford coaching figures, new on-street EV chargers, an electricity aggregation update filed with the state, and prerequisites for the state Climate Leaders designation.

items.title: Black Plastic Takeout Container Initiative
items.summary: Members discussed an Energy and Environment Committee effort to petition local food businesses to transition away from non-recyclable black plastic containers in favor of safer alternatives.
